nodes.label: User Access Code Page Mockup
nodes.description: Mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web dashboard with a modal dialog titled 'รหัสสำหรับการใช้งาน Extension' (Code for using the Extension) overlaid on top. The modal displays a 6-character user access code (e.g. '4AM1ER') shown as individual boxed characters, with a 'คัดลอก' (Copy) button below to copy the code for use in a companion browser extension. Behind the modal, the main dashboard shows the SEMD top navigation bar (dashboard, flag report, URL check, API key, terms of use, GitHub, and user profile icons), a URL/link checker input bar with a 'ตรวจเช็คลิงค์' (Check Link) field and 'ตรวจเช็ค' (Check) button alongside an SEMD ML model selector, and a 'รายงานล่าสุด' (Latest Reports) table listing reported URLs with columns for ID, URL, Reported at, Type (Malicious/Safe), Verify status (Checked/Pending), and Reported by (user or system).
